audit.why: Real kit: Hwei's abilities are Signature of the Visionary (P), Subject: Disaster (Q, damage), Subject: Serenity (W, utility/shield), Subject: Torment (E, crowd control — Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw), Spiraling Despair (R). All of Hwei's CC lives on E (Subject: Torment), not a 'Subject: Fear'.
